{{Quote|Good riddance to the Corellian creep, I say!|The Tusked criminal gives his opinion of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 79">[[Star Wars (1977) 79|''Star Wars'' (1977) 79]]</ref>}}
This '''Tusked criminal''' was a member of [[Lemo and Sanda's gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arcan IV]]. He was present in the [[Lemo and Sanda's den|gang's base]] during the gang's encounter with "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barpotomous Drebble/Legends|Drebble]]," [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in disguise. After helping to deface a wanted poster of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the alien witnessed the arrival of "Drebble" and his [[Chewbacca/Legends|nameless Wookiee]]. When [[Koruu]] attempted to kill Drebble for insulting [[Lemo]], the gang's leader, the tusked criminal was the first to exclaim Koruu's death when Calrissian threw a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] through Koruu's chest. Impressed with "Drebble's" skill, the tusked criminal accompanied the gang to a dinner to talk with Drebble about helping the gang find the valuable artifacts, the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]] and the [[Minstrel]]. The tusked criminal shared a glass of [[Deltron spice wine]] with "Drebble", but he poured out his drink in order to keep his head, as he was trying to get Calrissian drunk so that he would spill his plan and the gang could just kill the man and take his strategy for free.

During the dinner, this pirate let slip that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was being brought to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Since this was the information that Calrissian had been looking for, he let down his guard, accidentally revealing his true identity. With "Drebble" unmasked, the gang pulled their weapons on the man. However, Chewbacca came to Calrissian's rescue, attacking the group with a bench. The two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] were able to escape the planet despite attacks by the gang.
